The role provides advanced technical leadership and escalation support across Fibre, DWDM, and SDH platforms. As the highest level of operational escalation, the SNE Transmission Engineer leads complex fault diagnosis, restoration, problem management, and service assurance activities to minimise network impact and maximise service availability. Review alarms, events, and trends to identify operational risks. Lead technical investigations into complex faults and service impacts. Maintain operational readiness across supported platforms. Technical Leadership and Escalation Act as the highest-level operational escalation point for transmission incidents. Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex network faults. Provide expert guidance to engineers and operational teams. Support decision-making during major incidents and restoration activities. Drive engineering best practices and operational standards. Training, Coaching and Capability Development Act as a technical mentor across engineering teams. Identify capability gaps and develop targeted learning initiatives. Create and maintain training materials, documentation, and runbooks. Provide coaching to enhance troubleshooting and analytical skills. Facilitate post-incident knowledge transfer and lessons learned. Support career development, succession planning, and graduate/junior engineer programs. Assist leaders in evaluating technical competency and development requirements. Foster a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. Incident and Service Restoration Lead transmission fault management for critical and high-priority incidents. Drive restoration efforts to minimise customer and network impact. Coordinate internal teams, carriers, vendors, and field resources during outages. Support major incident management and recovery activities. Ensure timely communication and escalation of significant issues. Participate in incident reviews and post-incident analysis. Develop preventative measures to reduce recurrence. Service Assurance and Performance Management Monitor and analyse network performance and service quality. Identify emerging risks, recurring faults, and degradation trends. Drive improvements in availability, resilience, and customer experience. Ensure compliance with KPIs, SLAs, and operational objectives. Support capacity management and performance optimisation. Recommend improvements to network stability and operational effectiveness. Problem Management and Continuous Improvement Lead root cause analysis for major incidents and recurring faults. Develop and implement permanent corrective actions. Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements. Drive proactive maintenance and network health initiatives. Maintain operational standards, procedures, and technical documentation. Contribute to service improvement and operational maturity programs. Change and Operational Readiness Assess operational impacts of planned network changes. Review and approve high-risk transmission activities. Support change planning, implementation, and validation. Ensure teams are prepared to support new services and technologies. Participate in change governance and implementation reviews. Validate operational readiness for upgrades and new service introductions. Vendor and Stakeholder Management Work closely with vendors, carriers, and support partners. Manage technical escalations relating to transmission services. Engage with Engineering, Service Delivery, Customer Operations, and Program teams. Provide technical reporting and recommendations to stakeholders. Support customer-facing technical discussions where required. Build strong relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups. Strong experience supporting carrier-grade transmission networks. Experience with large-scale fibre transport and optical networks. Experience supporting Government, Defence, Emergency Services, or Critical Infrastructure networks. Proven capability troubleshooting complex faults in live environments. Experience supporting large-scale telecommunications infrastructure. Demonstrated leadership in incident resolution and service restoration. Experience coaching, mentoring, and developing technical teams. Experience producing training materials, procedures, and documentation. Strong understanding of 24x7 operational environments. review_candidates.title: Bid Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Bid Coordinator Company: United Delta for Information Technology Department: Commercial / Bid Management Reports To: Bid Manager Location: Cairo, Egypt Employment Type: Full-Time About United Delta United Delta is a technology and digital transformation company delivering enterprise solutions across the Middle East. Our capabilities span Hyperautomation & Low-Code, Middleware & API Management, Artificial Intelligence, Data & Analytics, CRM, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Airport Digital Transformation. We work closely with leading technology partners and enterprise and government customers to deliver complex digital transformation initiatives across the region. Role Overview United Delta is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bid Coordinator to support our Bid Manager and wider commercial team in managing the end-to-end coordination of proposals, tenders, RFPs, RFIs, and other bid submissions. The Bid Coordinator will play a key role in ensuring that bid activities are properly planned, coordinated, documented, and submitted on time. The successful candidate will work closely with Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Technology Practices, Partners, and Management to collect and consolidate the information required for high-quality and compliant submissions. This role is particularly suited to someone who is highly organized, comfortable working under deadlines, and capable of coordinating multiple stakeholders and bids simultaneously. Key Responsibilities Bid & Proposal Coordination Support the Bid Manager in coordinating the complete bid lifecycle for RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, proposals, and related commercial submissions. Review tender and RFP documentation to identify submission requirements, deadlines, mandatory documents, formats, and evaluation criteria. Prepare and maintain bid checklists, compliance matrices, submission trackers, and action plans. Coordinate the collection of technical, commercial, legal, financial, and administrative inputs from internal stakeholders. Track outstanding actions and proactively follow up with contributors to ensure deadlines are met. Coordinate clarifications and questions related to tender requirements. Support the preparation, formatting, consolidation, proofreading, and quality review of proposal documents. Ensure final submissions comply with customer instructions and United Delta's internal standards. Coordinate electronic and physical bid submissions where required. Internal Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with the Bid Manager, Sales, Presales, Delivery, Finance, Legal, HR, and Technology Practice teams throughout the bid process. Schedule and coordinate bid kick-off meetings, review sessions, and final submission reviews. Document agreed actions, owners, and deadlines and ensure appropriate follow-up. Escalate potential delays, missing inputs, compliance risks, and other bid-related issues to the Bid Manager. Support coordination with subcontractors and technology partners for quotations, Statements of Work, technical documentation, certifications, and other required inputs. Proposal Documentation & Quality Maintain United Delta's proposal templates and ensure consistent use of approved corporate formats. Support the preparation and maintenance of standard company information, capability statements, customer references, CVs, certifications, project references, and other reusable bid content. Review submissions for formatting, consistency, completeness, grammar, and overall presentation quality. Ensure appropriate document version control throughout the bid lifecycle. Maintain accurate records of submitted proposals and their supporting documentation. Bid Tracking & Reporting Maintain an up-to-date tracker of active, upcoming, submitted, won, lost, and cancelled bids. Track key bid milestones, submission dates, clarification deadlines, and dependencies. Support the Bid Manager in preparing regular bid status reports for management. Maintain records of bid outcomes and support win/loss analysis. Help maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, RFP responses, customer requirements, commercial documents, and reusable content. Support continuous improvement of United Delta's bid management processes, templates, and knowledge base. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 1–3 years of experience in bid coordination, proposal management, sales support, commercial operations, project coordination, or a similar role. Previous experience within an IT services, systems integration, consulting, software, or technology organization is highly preferred. Exposure to government or enterprise RFPs and tendering processes in Saudi Arabia or the GCC is an advantage. Experience coordinating multiple internal and external stakeholders under strict deadlines is highly desirable. Required Skills Excellent organizational and coordination skills. Strong attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Arabic and English. Arabic communication skills are highly desirable. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related productivity tools. Ability to understand and follow complex RFP instructions and compliance requirements. Strong document formatting and presentation skills. Effective stakeholder management and follow-up capabilities. Ability to manage multiple bids and competing deadlines simultaneously. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-driven environment. Preferred Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Highly organized – able to keep multiple submissions, documents, actions, and deadlines under control. Detail-oriented – capable of identifying missing information, inconsistencies, and compliance gaps. Proactive – follows up without waiting to be reminded. Deadline-driven – understands that bid submission deadlines are non-negotiable. Collaborative – comfortable coordinating with senior stakeholders across different functions. Commercially aware – understands that every proposal ultimately supports a business opportunity. Calm under pressure – able to maintain quality even during demanding submission periods. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance in this role will be measured against areas including: On-time bid submission rate. Bid compliance and completeness. Accuracy of bid documentation. Timely collection of stakeholder inputs. Quality and consistency of proposal documentation. Bid tracker and repository accuracy. Reduction in last-minute submission issues. Internal stakeholder responsiveness and coordination. Contribution to improving United Delta's overall bid management process. Working Relationship with the Bid Manager The Bid Coordinator will work closely with the Bid Manager , who will retain overall ownership of bid strategy, governance, commercial positioning, and final submission quality. The Bid Coordinator will primarily ensure that the operational and coordination aspects of each bid are executed effectively —including tracking requirements, coordinating stakeholders, managing documentation, monitoring deadlines, and ensuring submission readiness. Together, the Bid Manager and Bid Coordinator will ensure that United Delta's bids are compliant, competitive, professionally presented, and delivered on time .
